title: docs(adr-0050): Decision 2 notes that the add-record open mode is no longer declared on addRecord
body:
Refs #24692

The ADR half of letter B′ (ruling record [`6281834942`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/24692#issuecomment-6281834942), item 5; seat-2 hold [`6282077441`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/24692#issuecomment-6282077441): "the ADR-0050 Decision 2 note is Tier H, as its own one-line PR"). The spec half is PR #24970, which carries the card's closing keyword; this PR closes nothing.

**Tier H.** The diff touches `docs/adr/**`, a governed surface, so this PR lands only on an authorized APPROVED review (Prime Directive #14). It stays draft until then. **Land it after PR #24970**: the note says `addRecord.mode` / `addRecord.formView` *were* retired, which is true only once that PR is on `main`.

## What changes

`docs/adr/0050-form-layout-vs-presentation.md`, one file, +4 / -1:

- **Decision 2** gains a dated note, placed as a blockquote inside list item 2 (the numbering of items 3 and 4 is unchanged; checked by rendering the file):
  > **Note (2026-10-20, ruling record `6281834942`):** the list add-record open mode is no longer declared on `addRecord` — `addRecord.mode` and `addRecord.formView` were retired (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove); the create form is chosen by convention (`formViews.create` when declared, else `form` / `formViews.default`), how it opens stays the renderer's, and a per-list open mode, if ever wanted, is the list's existing `navigation.mode`, never a second enum.
- **Status line** gains a `· **Amended** (2026-10-20, letter B′ …) — … see the note under Decision 2.` segment, following the ADR-0069 / ADR-0088 / ADR-0043 convention. The status stays `Proposed`.

The original decision text is not rewritten. The Context bullet and the Non-goals line that also name `addRecord.mode` are left as written: they record what was true when the ADR was proposed, and the Status line points readers to the note.

## Acceptance notes

- No changeset. `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
- Gates at `fb75b6ae54`: `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reports 20 derived, 20 run, 0 not measured, each run with an exit code. `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-adr-links` (+ `--self-test`), `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (+ `--self-test`), `check:adr-anchors`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-prior-rulings` and the other 11 all exited 0. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first refused with exit 3 (a prerequisite was not built, so nothing was measured). After building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` it exited 0.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:ADR-0050 决策 2 下加一条带日期的注记,状态行加一段 Amended 指向它。原决策正文不动。

**为什么改**:裁决 B′ 退役了列表「新建记录」配置里的 `mode` / `formView` 两个键(声明了但渲染器从不执行)。ADR-0050 决策 2 原文还把 `addRecord.mode` 列为「表单在哪里打开」的承载者,不加注记的话,ADR 会指向一个已不存在的键。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文档,不影响运行时。须在 PR #24970 合入后再落地,否则注记先于事实。回滚:revert 本 PR 即可。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:PR #24970 合入后,对本 PR 给出批准(Approve)。
